## Description
Provide a summary of the changes and the reasoning behind them. If relevant, reference the associated issue (e.g. `Closes #123`).

## Type of Change
Select the type of change from the list:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Chore / Documentation / Refactor

## Git Flow Compliance
- [ ] This branch is created from `develop` (for features/fixes) or `master` (for hotfixes).
- [ ] The target branch is `develop` (for feature/fix/refactor/chore/docs/release) or `master` (for hotfix/release).

## Testing & Verification
Describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Automated tests pass locally (`npm run test`).
- [ ] Linter pass locally (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] TypeScript compiles with no errors (`npx tsc --noEmit`).
- [ ] Build succeeds locally (`npm run build`).

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots or screen recordings showing visual changes.

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, etc.) accordingly.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors.
